gallery-white.$description: Gallery White — Page canvas, header field, testimonial background, and unframed content surfaces

ink.$description: Ink — Headlines, body copy, logo, filled conversion buttons, accordion labels, and monochrome marks

paper-gray.$description: Paper Gray — Pill navigation backgrounds, quiet swatches, subdued icon containers, and low-contrast secondary surfaces

quiet-gray.$description: Quiet Gray — Muted attribution, supporting metadata, and secondary logo treatment

availability-green.$description: Availability Green — Small availability dots and live-capacity copy — a restrained signal against the otherwise achromatic interface

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

rhymes-text-light.$description: Primary editorial display face for multi-line section headlines. The 300 weight and aggressive -3.36px at 56px or -4.32px at 72px tracking make statements feel typeset rather than interface-generated.

rhymes-text-light-italic.$description: Italic interruption within Rhymes display headlines; use for one emotionally weighted word or closing phrase, not an entire paragraph. Its -3.36px at 56px and -5.04px at 72px tracking lets the italic splice lock tightly into the upright headline.

saans-regular.$description: Functional sans for body copy, labels, proof copy, and occasional oversized sans emphasis inside display lines. The 70px word treatment is deliberately a near-peer to the 72px Rhymes line, creating a blunt sans-versus-serif contrast.

saans-medium.$description: Compact emphasis for small labels and utility text without turning the interface into a bold sans system.

satoshi.$description: Tiny metadata inside portfolio imagery and embedded visual artifacts.
